title: Resolution and projection equations for sections data
statement: For transported scalar, evaluation and total-limit data D arising from a coefficient reduction R and finite tensor normalization hF, the prescribed resolution equation holds for the total-limit comparison and its actual finite projections agree with the scalar sections maps.

source.place: Tags 079P, 0941, 0D6E and 03CZ; extracted equation stage of the normalized coefficient-sections construction.

proof.text: Apply the normalized simultaneous sections/limit comparison to the transported derived pairs. Its universal-unit identity is the resolution equation. Identify each finite projection with the prescribed coefficient projection by uniqueness of the right-derived comparison and the transported ordinary section map.

proof_origin.place: Extracted equation stage of the normalized coefficient-sections construction.

from.place: Strictly smaller equation interface extracted from the core package.

mathlib_searches.results: Found the two generic comparison theorems used by the extracted interfaces.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientDerivedSectionsCoreEquations
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hF : CoefficientFiniteTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (D : CoefficientDerivedSectionsCoreData l E W R) :
    CoefficientDerivedSectionsCoreResolutionEquation l E W R D ∧
      (∀ (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W) (n : ℕ),
        D.globalLimit.hom.app M ≫
            (coefficientMappingProjection.{max u (t + 1)} n).app
              ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E W ⋙
                (coefficientTowerSections l E W).rightDerivedFunctor).obj M) ≫
            (D.systemSectionsEvaluation n).hom.app M =
          (coefficientIntegralSections l E W).map
              ((coefficientSequenceProjection l E W n).app M) ≫
            (D.scalar.scalarSections n).hom.app
              ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).obj M))
